decisions.reason: As a peripheral but relatively low-cost ecosystem option, the accelerator still offers partnership and deal-flow value, though after two years it faces the highest pruning risk if it does not translate into clearer strategic or commercial benefits.

The CO2-negative binder remains a strategic flagship with strong circular-economy fit, so real-options logic supports staying in the market while technical and commercial uncertainty continues to resolve.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is close to the firm’s core modular machinery business and suits a growing market, making continued retention the most likely choice unless demand disappoints materially.
